caseNameFull: Vela v. Vowell, Commissioner of Public Welfare of Texas

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. W. D. Tex. Motion of appellants to dispense with printing jurisdictional statement denied with leave to file a printed jurisdictional statement in conformity with Rule 39 of the Rules of this Court, or, if applicable, file *1155a motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis, with supporting affidavits, pursuant to Rule 53 of the Rules of this Court, on or before February 11, 1974.
